protocol_name: Methylation cell-type recognition from array intensities

ranking.formula: variance of training class means / (variance of training class means + mean training within-class variance)

nested.selection_score: mean inner balanced accuracy; equal to pooled inner balanced accuracy for the balanced folds
nested.selection_score_implementation: maximize integer correct count among the 35 inner validation predictions

fixed_size.selection: none; each stated size evaluated separately

classifier.centroid: arithmetic mean beta value for each class using training samples only
classifier.euclidean_prediction: minimum sum of squared beta differences
classifier.correlation_prediction: minimum one minus Pearson correlation across the signature coordinates
classifier.exact_class_distance_tie: stop and report the unresolved tie; do not choose an arbitrary class
classifier.undefined_correlation: stop and report the constant vector; do not replace correlation by zero

evaluation.balanced_accuracy: unweighted mean recall over true classes
evaluation.mutual_information: plug-in mutual information of true/predicted labels from normalized confusion counts, log base 2
